title: D.B. Cooper (Dagar Unfiltered Short, object transitions demo)

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: November 24th, 1971. A guy in a suit buys a plane ticket with cash. Name on the ticket? Dan Cooper.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: He orders a bourbon, lights a cigarette, and hands the flight attendant a note.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: His demands? Two hundred thousand dollars in cash, and four parachutes.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: In Seattle, he gets all of it. Then he lets every passenger go.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The plane takes off again, heading for Mexico.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Somewhere over the forests of Washington, he opens the back stairs. And jumps. Into the rain, in the dark, in a business suit.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The FBI chased him for forty five years. Over eight hundred suspects. Zero arrests.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Then in 1980, an eight year old kid digging by a river finds 5,800 dollars of the ransom money, rotting in the sand.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The rest? Gone. And so is he.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Even his name was a mistake. D.B. Cooper came from a reporter's mix up.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: So, did he die out there, or pull off the perfect crime?
